verdict.rationale: Fivetran's core product is background automation: pre-built connectors auto-sync on schedule, handle schema/API changes without manual intervention, and transformations execute automatically after syncs or on a set schedule — this is corroborated by community users describing it as a reliable 'set it and forget it' ETL layer. Missing for 10: independent evidence of fully unattended long-run reliability (community reports occasional sync failures/re-syncs needed) and clearer distinction between scheduled automation vs. true agentic/self-adapting behavior.
